messages:
tara: Heads-up — MercuryHealth reporting 3x tail latency on Dedicated pool (us-east-1) since ~03:00 UTC. Sales flagged as SLA. Need triage + decision: hotfix vs scheduled release? :warning:
lisa: FYI they pushed to prod yesterday and hit steady traffic. SLA says 99.9% p50/p95. They're on a committed plan; sales wants fastest path.
elaine: Prioritize. Two paths: 1) emergency routing/hotfix to bypass problematic nodes + canary then roll; 2) defer to next patch release and offer SLA credit. Engineering input?
michael: Can we get logs/traces first. My guess — transient KV cache thrashing + a few nodes showing GC stalls. Hotfix idea: route new requests to a warmed pool variant and force prefix-cache hit. Risk: small availability blip during switch.
samir: quick data: p95 spikes at 03:12 and 03:18, CPU/latency graphs attached (link). Sample jstack snippet below:
```
Thread-59 WAITING on java.lang.Object@7f3a
at sun.misc.Unsafe.park(Native Method)
at java.util.concurrent.locks.LockSupport.park(LockSupport.java:175)
```
dmitri: If we go hotfix we can flip routing flag for Mercury tenant in prod: `rctl set-route --tenant mercury --pool warmed-us-east-1 --force-canary false`
We can do canary to 5% of traffic first. Deploy path is ~20m for canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for mercury-warm-pool — canary-id bc4f2 · status: in_progress
elaine: Comms: if we do hotfix + canary, we should notify customer immediately (we're testing a routing adjustment) and follow up with results + ETA for full roll. If we delay to next release, prep SLA credit and set expectations (3-5 days).
tara: Proposed plan: run canary now (20m), monitor p95/p99 for 30m, if stable roll remaining traffic over next 2h. If canary fails rollback immediately and open incident page. Engineering owns rollout & rollback.
michael: Agreed. I'll push routing change, add temporary alert: `alerts.latency.p95 > 2s for 3m` -> pager to eng-oncall. I'll attach a small rollback script.
lisa: I'll draft the customer note: short, honest, put expected ETA and ops steps. Legal ok with credits if we need.
samir: Oncall will monitor and ready to rollback. Ping me in thread when canary is green. :thumbsup:
